ordering: Native queue ordering was independently audited against the exact pin: handlePan2f enqueues cancelPointerCapture's original-window release before orbit; GHOST pushes front/pops back and WM appends tail (FIFO). The active numeric UI handler calls ui_handle_button_event then synchronously ui_apply_but_funcs_after before returning; WM advances to the next event afterward. Its native restoration/repeat therefore finishes before the following navigation modal exists. UI handlers themselves are permitted by the native mode-safety gate. This is source ordering evidence, not target/device proof.
